title: Global Market: BOJ's Uchida warns AI boom could trigger market correction
key_facts: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Shinichi Uchida spoke on the effect of AI on the financial landscape
He noted that rising asset prices could trigger market corrections if expected AI returns fail to materialize
He suggested strong AI demand might change Japan's natural interest rate
quote_evidence: He noted that escalating asset prices could trigger market corrections if anticipated AI returns fail to materialize.
why_it_matters_hint: A central banker linking AI to both bubble risk and the long-run level of interest rates.
notes: Same Uchida speech (Tokyo, Monday 5 Oct 2026) as C07-05; the Economic Times page is a short summary with a lot of site boilerplate. Possible duplicate for the editor.
